entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra that escalated from a feud into a plane-spanning conflict of giant artifact creatures and set the future of Dominaria and the Multiverse in motion.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of the two brothers whose feud with Mishra erupted into the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: One of the two brothers whose feud with Urza erupted into the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose pivotal history the set revisits.

events.summary: A feud between Urza and Mishra erupts into an all-out war that sets the future of the plane and Multiverse in motion.
events.quote: what started as a feud between Urza and Mishra erupted into an all-out war that set into motion the future of the plane and Multiverse itself.

events.summary: In childhood the brothers grow up together and make a huge discovery that creates a schism.
events.quote: Childhood – We see the brothers growing up together and making a huge discovery that creates a schism

events.summary: In the final conflict the ultimate event ends the war and changes Dominaria forever.
events.quote: Final Conflict – We observe the ultimate event that ends the war and changes Dominaria forever.

relations.note: Their feud became the Brothers' War.
relations.quote: what started as a feud between Urza and Mishra erupted into an all-out war that set into motion the future of the plane and Multiverse itself.
